# Project Overview

This project is a component library built with React, TypeScript, and styled-components. It aims to provide a set of reusable, accessible, and customizable UI components for building modern web applications. It is open source but maintained by a small group.

## Folder Structure

- `.storybook` - Files required by the Storybook library for component development and testing.
- `src` - The main source folder containing all the components, hooks, and utilities.
- `dist` - The distribution folder for the built components.

## Libraries

- `styled-components` - For styling components using tagged template literals.
- `react` - For building user interfaces with components.
- `@storybook/react` - For developing and testing components in isolation.
- `vite` - A fast build tool and development server for modern web projects.
- `tippy.js/react` - For creating tooltips and popovers in React applications.
- `react-datepicker` - A simple and reusable datepicker component for React.
- `react-modal` - A flexible and accessible modal component for React.
- `react-select` - A flexible and customizable select input control for React.
